question: Should OpenClaw core accept default-off reset-family carryover that can prepend archived reset compaction summaries before the embedded-agent model boundary, and should it land as this combined stack or after the narrower includeFamily PR?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but automation cannot decide whether archived reset context should become a core prompt-injection capability or whether the includeFamily API should land separately before provider-boundary carryover is reviewed.

options.title: Land base first, then carryover
options.body: Merge or finalize https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 as the canonical family-history API, then rebase this PR down to the default-off carryover feature and provider-boundary proof.

options.title: Accept the combined stack
options.body: Land this PR as the combined includeFamily, session-lineage, and default-off carryover implementation if maintainers want one larger integration point.

options.title: Decline core carryover
options.body: Keep explicit family-history retrieval but close or narrow this PR if archived summaries should not be automatically injected into model prompts from core.

recommendation.title: Land base first, then carryover
recommendation.body: Merge or finalize https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 as the canonical family-history API, then rebase this PR down to the default-off carryover feature and provider-boundary proof.
